member.summary: Interface for providing custom authentication headers. Implement this interface to supply custom authentication logic (e.g. fetching tokens from a vault, using managed identity, etc.).

member.name: T:Databricks.Zerobus.ZerobusStream
member.summary: Represents an active bidirectional gRPC stream for ingesting records. Records can be ingested concurrently and will be acknowledged asynchronously.

remarks.para: The stream is thread-safe — you may call from multiple threads concurrently, just like the Go SDK supports goroutines.
Ingestion is asynchronous: returns as soon as the record is queued; the SDK tracks its acknowledgment in the background.

performs a graceful close (flush + close) but keeps the native stream alive so callers can inspect or recover with ZerobusSdk.RecreateStream(...). Call when you are completely finished with the stream to free native resources.

ZerobusSdk.RecreateStream(stream) consumes stream and returns a replacement stream wrapper. The original wrapper is disposed during recreation. performs the same graceful close as without blocking the calling thread, enabling await using for streams.

member.remarks:
When one or more valid methods with this attribute are found in a compilation, the compiler will emit a module initializer which calls each of the attributed methods.
Certain requirements are imposed on any method targeted with this attribute: - The method must be `static`. - The method must be an ordinary member method, as opposed to a property accessor, constructor, local function, etc. - The method must be parameterless. - The method must return `void`. - The method must not be generic or be contained in a generic type. - The method's effective accessibility must be `internal` or `public`.
The specification for module initializers in the .NET runtime can be found here: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/design/specs/Ecma-335-Augments.md#module-initializer
